positive.description: Spanish educational reference, no intake required. Exact anatomical goblet squat identity and localized teaching/video, no individualized medical clearance or claimed playback.

positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the current goblet_squat reference with locale es. Show its admitted anatomical video and Spanish setup/cues/dose as a catalog reference, without asking for a full training profile.

positive.description: Complete fictional adult beginner context. Paired dumbbells, floor and knee padding, no other supports. Current pain/restriction absent. No demonstrated advanced capability.
positive.prompt: Sou adulto iniciante, sem dor ou restrições, e quero força geral para o tênis. Tenho 25 minutos, um par de halteres, chão e apoio acolchoado para os joelhos; não tenho banco nem rack. Jogo tênis terça e quinta, sem partida nas próximas 24 horas. Monte uma sessão simples com vídeos.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale pt and beginner environment with only explicitly confirmed equipment/supports. Select current eligible IDs, preserve native units/sides and show a valid session whose maximum modeled time, including its 120-second buffer, is at most 25 minutes.

positive.description: Multi-turn adaptation using only supplied fictional context. First obtain the valid session from the preceding beginner case; the next prompt changes time only.
positive.prompt: Agora só tenho 8 minutos. Encurte essa sessão mantendo os mesmos equipamentos e mostre o que mudou.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the established current context. Reduce sets/targets or number of suitable movements without increasing native volume or inventing interval overrides. Revalidate and display a session with maximum modeled duration at most 8 minutes; explain the reduction.

positive.description: Fictional adult intermediate, no current pain/restriction, no match within 24h. A single dumbbell is explicit; no pair, bench, rack, anchors or advanced capabilities are confirmed.
positive.prompt: I am an adult intermediate player without pain or restrictions. I have 20 minutes, the floor and one dumbbell, not a pair. No match in the next 24 hours. Suggest a controlled session and show the anatomical videos.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale en and equipment dumbbells rather than dumbbell_pair. Do not infer a pair, support or demonstrated capability. Choose eligible movements, show a validated session within 20 minutes and explain choices without prescribing a precise weight.

positive.description: Fictional adult intermediate, comfortable exercise and no restriction, floor only; controlled landing is demonstrated but a match is tomorrow.
positive.prompt: Sou adulto intermediário, sem dor ou restrição. Tenho 15 minutos e apenas o chão. Já pratico aterrissagens controladas, mas minha partida é amanhã, em menos de 24 horas. Quero uma opção leve e bem explicada para hoje, com os vídeos.
positive.expected_behavior: Set matchWithin24Hours true and use only the confirmed floor/capability environment. Exclude all native power movements even with landing capability. Show an eligible controlled session within 15 minutes, preserving dose units and explaining match-load reasoning.
